name: Log Client
description: Log Client: an independent Fabric client for Minecraft 1.21.1. It records and searches chat, tracks player activity and session statistics, raises keyword alerts, forwards reports to a webhook, drops schematic materials, runs an autonomous task bot, checks GitHub Releases for updates and serves a local web console on 127.0.0.1:6767. Baritone drives navigation, mining and building when it is installed.
